meta.name: add-dial
meta.description: Add Dial channel integration — a real phone number for SMS and AI voice calls via the Dial platform (getdial.ai). Native adapter — no Chat SDK bridge.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 给应用接入真实号码,支持短信与AI语音通话
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果正在开发需要电话或短信能力的应用
copy.tagline_en: Add a real phone number for SMS and AI voice calls to your app
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you're building an app that needs phone or SMS capabilities

howto.what: 给 Claude 装上一个真实的 Dial 手机号，可收发短信、用 AI 接听语音来电。安装会复制 Dial 适配器、注册频道、装依赖、构建并跑一次注册测试。
howto.when: 当你希望 Claude 拥有一个真实电话号码（收发短信或接打电话）、并按此技能步骤安装 Dial 频道时触发。安装中会询问谁可以给这个号码发消息。

say.text: 帮我把 Dial 频道装上，给我一个真实手机号
say.note: 会开始复制适配器、注册频道并构建

say.text: 用 Dial 给这个号码发一条短信测试
say.note: 从已配好的 Dial 线路发出短信

say.text: 把 Dial 号码的来电问候语改成留言提示
say.note: 设置号码接听来电时的 AI 提示词

howto.what_en: Gives Claude a real Dial phone number for SMS and AI voice calls. Install copies the Dial adapter, registers the channel, installs deps, builds, and runs one registration test.
howto.when_en: Use when you want Claude to have a real phone number for SMS or calls and run this skill to install the Dial channel. Setup also asks who may text the line.

say_en.text: Install the Dial channel and give me a real phone number
say_en.note: Copies the adapter, registers it, builds

say_en.text: Send an SMS from my Dial line to test it
say_en.note: Sends from the configured Dial line

say_en.text: Change my Dial number's inbound call greeting
say_en.note: Sets the AI prompt for inbound calls
